spans.s: nāṇā (EI 30), name of a coin; same as nāṇaka.
nāṇai (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXX, p. 197, text line 18), same as Sanskrit nāṇaka; ‘a coin.’
nāṇaka , a coin; see nāṇai, nānā.

Nāṇī (CII 4), an engraver; probably a corruption^1 of Vijñānin.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
